title: calrcpsp: calendar-aware resource-constrained project scheduling in Python
description: A Python library for project scheduling under work-calendar constraints. It reads the published CA-RCPSP benchmark format, builds and solves max-plus scheduling matrices, and returns start times, makespan, task slack, the critical path, resource utilisation and two calendar compliance measures. It also applies a disruption and repairs the schedule. Shifts, breaks and holidays are handled exactly through a cumulative work-time function and its inverse, with no quantisation of start and finish times.
